detail.longDescription: I'm looking for a FOSS # selfhosted option for organizing and tracking my books, comics, and DVD collection. I have my eye on # homebox but don't know if that's the correct solution. Location tracking is important, I'm tired of misplacing things. I want to run this containerised on a # raspberrypi 4 or 5. So, nothing too heavy. Suggestions? # askfedi
